claim: Lazy decay and event-routed active execution reduce audited algorithmic work relative to a dense-equivalent implementation while preserving target behavior in fixed sparse workloads.
non_claims: No use of historical exploratory H5 results as evidence or parameter selection.

runtime_binding.notes: The H5 candidate, standalone comparator, workload, counter, scorer and preserver use Python stdlib plus the bound SparkBrain source only. Pytest and Ruff are readiness tooling, not scientific runtime dependencies.

candidate.name: sparkbrain_event_routed_lazy
candidate.semantics: Bound SparkBrain queued-event execution with lazy per-Spark closed-form decay on touch, active outgoing-edge fanout on firing, and current all-edge eligibility decay per event.

comparator.name: sparkbrain_dense_eager_equivalent
comparator.semantics: Standalone array-based eager implementation of the same H5 state equations. It materializes the full node state once at each distinct event time, applies the same per-event all-edge eligibility decay, processes the same ordered external/propagation messages, and derives circulant fanout directly without invoking SparkBrain or the candidate transition path.
comparator.scheduler: Independent time-bucket calendar keyed by exact float event times; events are processed by priority and insertion order, preserving the candidate H5 ordering semantics without reusing candidate queue code.

sparse_primary.aggregation: equal weight across all family-size-activity strata within each seed, then equal weight across seeds

dense_control.role: diagnostic only; excluded from primary sparse PASS/FAIL statistic

dev_only_validation.allowed_use: mechanical equivalence, state-equation parity and counter-invariant validation only; no threshold, workload, margin, dense-design or statistic selection

audited_work.metric: unit-weight sum of prospectively named primitive algorithmic actions
audited_work.scheduler_rule: Each implementation is charged one scheduler write per stored event/message and one scheduler read per executed event/message. Heap/calendar comparison micro-costs are not separately weighted.
audited_work.implementation_specific_rule: Candidate fanout container lookup is charged only to the candidate because the dense comparator derives fixed circulant targets directly. Dense full-state materialization is charged only when the dense algorithm actually advances to a new event time. No output-neutral scan is added merely to inflate dense work.
audited_work.notes: Both sides count target accesses, per-event all-edge eligibility decay, routed edge checks, message traversals, activation/eligibility/threshold additions and residual multiplication when genuinely executed. The schema intentionally permits either implementation to win.

primary_statistic.seed_level_statistic: equal-weight mean across all sparse family-size-activity strata
primary_statistic.multiplicity: single primary statistic; activity-level reductions are deterministic gate summaries, other cell-level analyses descriptive only

decision_rule.pass: All quality guards pass; primary 95% CI lower bound >= 0.20; and each sparse activity-fraction mean work reduction >= 0.10.
decision_rule.fail: All quality guards pass and either primary 95% CI upper bound <= 0.05 or every sparse activity-fraction mean work reduction <= 0.0.
decision_rule.inconclusive: All quality guards pass and neither PASS nor FAIL condition holds.
decision_rule.invalid: Any quality guard, join/cardinality, counter invariant, exact binding or evidence-integrity check fails.

raw_preservation_contract.raw_fields: workload identifiers, candidate/dense named counters, total work, full logical-state equivalence observations and counter invariants

stop_rule: Stop after green readiness at H5_REVISED_DENSE_COMPARATOR_READY_FOR_ANALYST_REVIEW. Fresh Evidence Analyst acceptance is required before identity reservation, STARTED, official TEST, preservation, formal scoring or evidence creation.
